name: Employee Sales
query:
SELECT
     e."full_name" AS "Employee",
    date_list."date" AS "Date",
    COUNT(b."name") AS "Total Invoices",
    SUM(b."grand_total") AS "Sales Amount"
FROM generate_series(%(start_date)s::date, %(end_date)s::date, interval '1 day') AS date_list(date)
LEFT JOIN "tabPOS Invoice" b ON (
    b."branch" = %(branch)s
    AND b."status" IN ('Consolidated','Paid') 
    AND b."docstatus" = 1
)
INNER JOIN "tabUser" e ON(
    e."name"= b."waiter"
)
LEFT JOIN "tabURY Report Settings" rs ON (
    rs."branch" = %(branch)s
)
WHERE
(
    ((rs."hours" IS NULL OR rs."hours" = 0) AND b."posting_date" = date_list."date")
    OR (rs."hours" > 0 AND (b."posting_date" + b."posting_time") <= (date_list."date" + interval '1 day' + make_interval(hours => rs."hours"::integer)) AND (b."posting_date" + b."posting_time") >= (date_list."date" + make_interval(hours => rs."hours"::integer)))
    OR (rs."branch" IS NULL AND b."posting_date" = date_list."date")
)
GROUP BY 
    date_list."date",e."full_name"    
ORDER BY 
    date_list."date" DESC
